name: tap-static-vendor
description: TAP's vendored browser-library closure (req-cicd-sbom-13, adopt-native-distribution): these exact-pinned npm packages are fetched by the js-vendor Docker build stage (npm ci --ignore-scripts) and staged into /opt/tap-static-vendor — the bytes never live in git. package-lock.json is the integrity + SBOM seam (the image scan catalogs it); Renovate updates ride this file like any other lockfile.
